Interface DataKey.Transferable<I extends DataHolder.Mutable<I>, N extends DataHolder.Mutable<N>, D>

Type Parameters:
I - The original data holder
N - The new data holder
D - The expected type of the value
All Superinterfaces:
DataKey<D>, DataKey.Native<N,D>
All Known Implementing Classes:
EntityKey, EntityKey.Defaulted, EntityKey.Mapped
Enclosing interface:
DataKey<D>
public static interface DataKey.Transferable<I extends DataHolder.Mutable<I>, N extends DataHolder.Mutable<N>, D> extends DataKey.Native<N,D>
Makes the key transferable from one DataHolder to another. The key must be native to the holder the value is being transferred to. This is typically used where both data holder's are the same type
